description: LATE BOX ARRIVALS 10 - ADMIT THE DEEP MIDFIELDER. vf4 restricts the candidate to position classes 4..6 (CMF, LMF/RMF, AMF) via two private imm8 compares. This is the change most likely to cost defensive shape on the counter - apply alone and watch. Revert: python tools/exe_patch.py remove tools/data/patches/latebox-admit-dmf.json
